case_module.claim: Resubmitting an already-applied command is independent of the reachable configuration it is replayed from. The Given asserts one pre-state (the account exists, the cart holds sku-1, order-1 is accepted and queued) instead of enumerating the 504 distinct projected before-states the whole view reaches, and that assertion IS the 504 -> 12 reduction. What it claims is irrelevant to duplicate handling: cart contents and order fan-out. If duplicate handling ever reads either, the claim is false and the Given must go.
case_module.name: Scenario_IdempotentResubmit
